name: has_name
title: Does an object have an element with this name?

origin.description: Reports whether a column name is present.
origin.details: Reports whether a column name is present.
origin.value: has_name of a frame with column a returns TRUE for a and FALSE for nope.

translation.description: Reports whether a column name is present.
translation.details: Reports whether a column name is present.
translation.value: has_name of a frame with column a returns True for a and False for nope.
translation.example:
from tibble import has_name, new_tibble
frame = new_tibble([[1]], names=["a"], nrow=1)
print(has_name(frame, "a"))
print(has_name(frame, "nope"))
